name: Kitten Forest
lore: Past the Goblin King's throne the road runs on into a lantern-lit wood of giant toadstools, where kittens nap, play and make mischief in every glade.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; 103 candidates, 50 picks and 27 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/01-kitten-forest/README.md). Each picture's file is the subject-cropped 160 px source with its fixed chroma (that README's hand-off warning), so convert gives back exactly the boards the picks were judged on.

profile.note: Land 1 (tools/land-01-notes.md §2): clearly harder than levels 101-200 on average. Tags E4/N21/H17/X8 in a sawtooth of five runs (Normal lead, Hard run, Extreme peak, Easy breather; runs of 5, the later peaks with 2 Extremes), ending Extreme at 250. Features: ? cards on 40% (2-4 each), mystery blocks on 30% (of 0.18-0.34 of the buried blocks with the blob gap: about 15-30% of the picture), linked squads on 36%, a lock on every Hard and Extreme level (colour, or key where the gilt clears the picture). Bands and lookahead ceilings below the castle's 151-200 (Normal 0-10%, Hard and Extreme 0-5%, a lookahead ceiling of 0.25 on all three; picked: Normal random-tap median 5.3% and lookahead 0.12, Hard 0.5% and 0.11, Extreme 1.0% and 0.18): Normal gets a ceiling of 0.30 (without one the first bake's Normals had lookahead 0.86; at 0.15 eleven of 21 found no candidate in 30, at 0.20 six still none in 22: the one-move-lookahead rate of a plain picture with no deck feature depends mostly on the picture), Hard and Extreme a 0-1% band (the pick leans to the band's middle) and ceilings of 0.15 and 0.10, with more candidates per level (--extra). Pictures that could not get under their ceiling in 30 tries (few colours, one big subject: snow leopard, bath time, lion cub, soccer kick) take the four Easy breathers, which have no ceiling; 16 slots changed in all, no two neighbours sharing a category (tools/land-01-notes.md §2). Pace aim 200 s: the locked Hard and Extreme levels run long (median 250-265 s), so the pick leans the rest shorter and the land's median stays inside 200-250 s.
